title: Password strength
description:
Write `bool isStrongPassword(std::string_view password)`. A strong password:

- is at least 8 characters long,
- has at least one upper-case letter,
- has at least one lower-case letter,
- has at least one digit,
- contains no spaces.

Loop over the characters once (a `for` loop over the indexes, reading `password[i]`), setting a `bool` flag for each thing you find. `std::isdigit` from `<cctype>` (lesson 2.04) does the digit test, and its relatives `std::isupper` and `std::islower` test for upper- and lower-case letters in the same way.
hints: Check the length first and leave early. Then one loop with three flags, and at the end `return hasUpper && hasLower && hasDigit;`
lessonTitle: Halts, goto, and Testing Your Code
